title: Lock order inversion rule
summary: One project-wide lint rule: two places take the same two locks in opposite order, directly or through a called routine, so two threads can deadlock
intro: Read this when a threaded program hangs with no exception and no log, or before you add a second lock to a class. Run `drag-lint lint-all --db <project.sqlite> --rule lock-order-inversion`; the rule reads the project index, so it sees both places even when they are in different units. It is ON by default.
